- Introduced etix-mcp: search Etix events, venues, and performers, and retrieve detailed event/venue info via MCP.
- Requires the etix-mcp package and the fetchproxy browser extension with an open etix.com tab.
- Supports tools for searching, getting details, location resolution, and bridge health checks.
- User requests are routed through your real browser session for compatibility with Etix’s DataDome protection.
- No Etix account or public API is required; works with public event-discovery data.
